name: 2 Corinthians
author: The apostle Paul.
setting: Paul defends his ministry and urges generosity and reconciliation.
theme: God’s power appears in weakness, and the new covenant ministry gives new life.

outline.label: Comfort and the change of plans
Treasure in jars of clay and reconciliation
The fool’s speech and the thorn in the flesh

christInBook: Paul says that the one who knew no sin became sin for us (5:21), that Christ’s grace was sufficient in weakness (12:9), and that God has shone in our hearts to give the light of the knowledge of the glory of God in the face of Christ (4:6).
howToRead: 2 Corinthians is Paul’s most personal letter. Notice how he defends his ministry not by showing strength, but by showing weakness, and how he ties his suffering to the cross.
